source_name: Komisija za tržište kapitala — Učesnici na tržištu (licensed market participants)
why_relevant: Register extracts of licensed brokers, investment firms, custodians and fund managers — enumerates the non-bank financial actor set whose director changes are also CRPS-filed.

source_name: Komisija za tržište kapitala — annual report on the capital market
why_relevant: Annual regulator report enumerates licensed entities, licence decisions and enforcement over the year — a compact retrospective ground truth for reconciling a year of entity/leadership changes.

source_name: Montenegroberza / MNSE — issuer announcements (obavještenja emitenata)
why_relevant: The Montenegro Stock Exchange publishes issuer notices; listed banks announce shareholder-meeting decisions including board elections, typically ahead of the register showing the change.

source_name: CompanyWall Business Crna Gora
why_relevant: Regional credit-bureau aggregator that ingests Montenegrin registry and Tax/Customs Administration data and presents responsible persons (odgovorna lica), ownership structure to ultimate owner, related parties and financials — a far more scrapable/queryable surface than the raw CRPS UI, and it spans SI/HR/RS/MK/HU for cross-border group links.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Montenegro Central Register of Business Entities mirror
why_relevant: Standardised, API-accessible mirror of CRPS records including officer names — useful as a normalised backbone and change-detection layer when the native register is hard to automate.

source_name: Uprava prihoda i carina (Revenue and Customs Administration) — institutional site
why_relevant: The administrative owner of CRPS and of annual financial statement filings; its notices announce register procedure changes, filing deadlines and portal migrations that affect any collection pipeline built on CRPS.

source_name: eUprava Crne Gore — e-government service catalogue (register services)
why_relevant: Catalogues the formal service routes for register extracts (izvod iz CRPS), free-access-to-information requests and financial statement filing — i.e. the legal/manual fallback path when automated register access is blocked.

source_name: CompanyData.com / BoldData — Montenegro company database (CRPS-derived)
why_relevant: Bulk commercial dataset sourced from CRPS (~92k entities, 69k corporations as of mid-2026) with 50+ fields and API access — a way to obtain the full entity universe as a file rather than crawling the register.

source_name: HitHorizons — Montenegro company database
why_relevant: Pan-European registry aggregator covering Montenegrin entities; useful for cross-border parent/subsidiary resolution of foreign-owned Montenegrin banks (NLB, OTP/CKB, Erste-type groups).

source_name: Info-clipper — Montenegro company search (D&B-sourced)
why_relevant: Sells per-company reports built on Dun & Bradstreet plus local sources, including directors and shareholders — a paid corroboration route for a specific entity when register access fails.

source_name: Prva banka Crne Gore — Upravni odbor (issuer governance page, exemplar)
why_relevant: Exemplar of the per-bank governance page pattern: each licensed bank publishes its own upravni/nadzorni odbor and management. These pages update faster than aggregators and are the natural per-entity diff target once CBCG's register supplies the entity list.

source_name: Uprava za ljudske resurse - Oglašavanje (gov.me institutional page)
why_relevant: Institutional gov.me page explaining the vacancy-advertising regime (categories, deadlines, link between Budget Law + Kadrovski plan and when senior-management competitions open). Gives the rules that let you predict WHEN public banking/finance bodies can legally hire.

source_name: Vlada Crne Gore - Saopštenja o kadrovskim pitanjima (government personnel decisions)
why_relevant: After each Government session a dedicated 'Saopštenje o kadrovskim pitanjima' lists every appointment/dismissal the Government made - including boards and directors of IRF CG, Kreditno-garantni fond, Pošta Crne Gore and finance-ministry state secretaries. This is the single richest recurring feed of state-side leadership moves in banking/payments.

source_name: Ministarstvo finansija Crne Gore - vijesti i javni pozivi
why_relevant: Core cell actor. Publishes news, javni pozivi and public consultations; announces state-secretary/directorate-level changes and treasury/payment-system project staffing. Note: it does NOT carry its own vacancy list - those route to uzk.gov.me.

source_name: Investiciono-razvojni fond Crne Gore (IRF CG) - official site
why_relevant: State development bank and a lending/financing actor. Board (Odbor direktora) and executive-director changes are Government-appointed and announced here and via gov.me; also a hirer of credit/risk/IT staff.

source_name: Pošta Crne Gore AD - Menadžment / o kompaniji
why_relevant: State-owned post is a payments actor (platni promet at counters, international money transfer). The Menadžment page is the authoritative roster of executive director and Odbor direktora; changes there signal shifts in the postal-payments channel.

source_name: Skupština Crne Gore - Administrativni odbor (sjednice, javni pozivi za izbor i imenovanja)
why_relevant: Parliamentary body that runs the javni poziv procedures and proposes/handles elections and appointments to independent regulators and bodies appointed by Parliament (incl. Capital Market Authority, CBCG Governor/Council path). Session agendas and materials are the earliest formal signal of an upcoming leadership change.

source_name: Službeni list Crne Gore (Official Gazette) - odluke o imenovanju / rješenja
why_relevant: Legally authoritative record: every appointment/dismissal decision (odluka o imenovanju, rješenje o razrješenju) and every statute/systematisation act of public financial bodies is published here. Best ground-truth to confirm and date leadership and organizational changes.

source_name: Prekoveze.me - Montenegrin job portal
why_relevant: Named by CBCG itself as one of the channels where its vacancies are posted; a commercial aggregator that captures both public-sector-adjacent and private banking/payments roles, with employer-filtered listing pages.

source_name: Agencija za sprječavanje korupcije - Javni registri (public officials register)
why_relevant: Register of public officials and their income/asset declarations. Because directors and board members of state financial institutions (IRF, FZD, KGF, Pošta CG, regulators) are registered public officials, entries and their start/end dates provide an independent, structured cross-check of leadership moves and of concurrent board memberships.

source_name: MANS - Imovinafunkcionera.me (NGO officials asset/appointment portal)
why_relevant: NGO-built searchable portal consolidating official asset declarations plus research on Montenegrin public officials. Useful as a secondary index over the same appointment universe when the ASK register is hard to query; MANS also publishes investigative pieces on state financial institutions' management.

source_name: Bankar.me - Montenegrin banking & finance trade media
why_relevant: Sector-specialist outlet that systematically covers management/board changes across Montenegrin banks and state financial institutions (incl. dedicated tag pages such as 'upravni odbor', and analyses of governance-model shifts to supervisory+management boards). Fast, low-friction detection layer to be confirmed against gov.me/Službeni list.

source_name: RTCG (public broadcaster) - Ekonomija / Politika sections
why_relevant: National public broadcaster reliably reports Government appointment rounds ('Vlada imenovala i razriješila više kadrova...'), IRF director changes, and systemic hiring-freeze stories such as blocked state-administration competitions - a signal about whether public-sector hiring is even possible in a given period.

source_name: Portal Analitika - Ekonomija (staffing-plan and vacancy reporting)
why_relevant: Covers ministry-level Kadrovski plan detail (systematised vs filled vs vacant posts, planned new hires) and board compositions of state financial institutions - quantitative organization-change signal that rarely appears elsewhere in narrative form.

source_name: MINA news agency - business/economy wire
why_relevant: National news agency; MINA-business covers governance events such as banks forming supervisory and management boards under the new Law on Credit Institutions - i.e. sector-wide organizational change, not just single appointments.

source_name: eUprava Crne Gore - service catalogue (Saglasnost na imenovanje izvršnog direktora)
why_relevant: Documents the administrative procedure by which the state grants consent to the appointment of an executive director in state-owned companies, and catalogues services of the Capital Market Authority. Explains WHO must approve an appointment and WHICH body issues the paper trail - useful for knowing where to look for each institution.
